flagged.comment: Restrictive covenant for Integrated Pest Management (IPM) plan required for biofiltration pond facility has not been recorded. Cover sheet Block 12 shows blank document number for IPM covenant ('For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________'). The recorded IPM restrictive covenant document number must be completed and updated on the cover sheet, and evidence of City Law Department approval and county recordation must be provided.

Integrated Pest Management (IPM) restrictive covenant required for the biofiltration/detention pond has not been demonstrated as submitted to City Law Department for review and written approval prior to recordation. Water Quality review comment WQ 12 indicates the IPM plan is pending submission; no evidence of covenant submittal to City Law is provided.

Restrictive covenant form and completeness cannot be verified; the IPM covenant document is not recorded (blank document number on cover sheet). Submit the executed, notarized IPM restrictive covenant (approved by City Law Department) and evidence of county recordation to verify compliance with form and content requirements.

IPM restrictive covenant in the form approved by City Law Department has not been provided. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains a blank document number field, and no covenant document with exhibits, lien search, affidavit, or consents has been submitted for review.

Proposed biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, and associated improvements are located in the NE interior area where the recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, perpetual no-build zone) exists. No documentation of easement vacation, release, or modification authorizing these improvements within the easement boundaries has been provided. The proposed development is not compatible with a perpetual no-build easement without formal easement modification or vacation.
areas: NE interior area of site, detention pond location

flagged.comment: Biofiltration/detention pond facility is located partially within the existing recorded City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, NE corner). The easement grant document reserves unlimited rights for City to construct, operate, and maintain drainage infrastructure; any on-site improvements require City (Watershed Protection Department) coordination and approval. Evidence of City coordination and approval for pond location within easement must be provided; alternatively, demonstrate that pond layout avoids the easement area entirely.

Several easements on the site plan have document numbers that are cut off, obscured, or illegible, including Wastewater Easement, Sidewalk Easement (two locations), and Existing Water Line Vault Easement on the western boundary. Additionally, the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement is labeled with an apparently transposed document number (2010070273 shown vs. recorded 2010070731). All easements must be clearly labeled with legible, accurate recording information showing document number and volume/page or instrument number. Revise to ensure all easement labels are complete, legible, and accurate.
areas: Western boundary, eastern boundary, site perimeter

flagged.comment: Proposed easements (wastewater and sidewalk easements shown on site plan) are not clearly designated with 'proposed' labels; instead, they show blank document numbers ('Doc# _______'). All proposed easements must be explicitly labeled as 'PROPOSED' on site plan sheets to distinguish them from recorded (existing) easements, which must show recording information (volume/page or document number).
areas: Site plan sheets (wastewater easement, sidewalk easement areas)

flagged.comment: A comprehensive inventory of all required or proposed legal instruments (recorded easements, proposed easements, drainage easement documents, restrictive covenants, license agreements) is not clearly identified and listed on the site plan cover sheet or in the comment response letter. Provide a consolidated table or note on the cover sheet identifying the status, location, and document numbers for all legal instruments required for the project.
areas: Site plan (cover sheet and all plan sheets)

flagged.comment: Required legal instrument (IPM restrictive covenant for biofiltration pond) not properly identified and listed on site plan or in comment response letter. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains the template text 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas' but the document number field is blank, indicating the required legal instrument is not complete or identified.
areas: cover sheet; IPM/maintenance covenant for detention pond

flagged.comment: Single-lot site should not include multi-lot or cohesive development notes. If such notes are present on the cover sheet, they must be removed or clarified to reflect single-lot status.

The City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, NE corner, 0.130 acres, perpetual) required for drainage facilities is not depicted on the drainage or site plan sheets. County records and applicant communication confirm this easement exists and affects the property. The easement must be clearly delineated on site plan showing its location, boundaries, and recording information to demonstrate that development does not conflict with City's right to access and maintain the drainage facility.
areas: NE corner and eastern portion of site

flagged.comment: Drainage easement documents for the 25-foot drainage easement and City of Austin drainage easement shown on the site plan have not been demonstrated as submitted to City Legal Department for review and approval prior to recordation. Drainage Engineering review comment DE 3 (Pending status) specifically requests 'Please provide the drainage easement document' indicating the document has not been provided.

Two critical existing recorded easements are not properly identified on the site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (recorded Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior no-build zone) is mislocated and shown with incorrect document number (2010070273); (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner) is not depicted at all. County records confirm both are perpetual easements encumbering the property. Provide correct identification and location of all existing recorded easements affecting the property.

The Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) is recorded as a perpetual no-build zone covering 0.31 acres in the NE interior. The site plan shows biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, BBQ area, and other improvements in this same NE interior area, but it cannot be verified from available documents whether applicant has reviewed the recorded easement terms to determine compatibility with the proposed development in this area. Provide evidence of easement review and confirmation that proposed improvements do not violate the no-build restriction.
areas: Property development, easement areas, detention pond location
